decisions.reason: Premium customer support sits at the heart of the firm's promise of tailored expert service, so prior commitment and easy justification of any weak results as temporary make withdrawal unlikely.
The software version management tool builds on the firm's platform and its automation strategy, and despite weaker later visibility the invested development effort still favors persistence over exit.
The data processing contract tool is more distant from the core hosting and support business, and after several years its weaker strategic fit outweighs earlier investment and public presentation.
Scalable hosting for agencies was launched as a flagship line close to the core business, so the firm's public strategic commitment strongly encourages continued support rather than withdrawal.
